## 使用截图 / Screenshots

**她就住在 DSH 里。** 裙摆、发梢和尾巴会轻轻飘动。头顶小标签显示梁文峰 / 梁文谷时段和账户余额；时段切换时她会换个表情告诉你。
**She lives inside DSH.** Her
skirt, hair ends and tail sway gently. Chips above her head show the DeepSeek pricing period (梁文峰 =
peak, 梁文谷 = off-peak) and your balance; she announces each period switch with a new expression.

设置面板贴在她身旁，不会挡住她：余额卡片、计费时段，以及到几点结束。
Settings sit beside her, never on top: balance, pricing period an

d when it ends.
浅色主题，周末全天梁文谷（半价）。主题只影响插件本身。
Light theme; weekends are off-peak all day. Themes affec
t only the companion.
**GalGame 对话剧场：** 点击输入框即可进入。全屏场景、居中的立绘、深蓝毛玻璃对话框和名字标签；她的表情会随每一页台词变化，头顶冒出情绪符号；文字逐字淡入，可以快进，代码有专门的卡片。
**Visual-novel theatre:** click the chat box to enter. A full-screen scene, a centred portrait and a
deep-blue glass dialogue box with a name tag; her expression changes with each page, with a mood ma
rk above her head; text fades in character by character, with Skip, and code gets copyable cards.
**四套背景，也能用你自己的图：** 和室书房·夜、科技机房、午后咖啡厅、海边黄昏，默认跟随时间切换，切换时 0.7 秒交叉淡入；也可以保留「透明」显示 DSH。
**Four backgrounds, or your own picture:** a study at night, a server room, an afternoon café and a
seaside dusk, following the time of day by default, with a 0.7 s crossfade; “Transparent” keeps DSH
dusk, following the time of day by default, with a 0.7 s crossfade; “Transparent” keeps DSH visible.
**背景音乐与背景切换：** 左上角的小按钮打开音乐、背景和剧场设置。三首内置曲目「日常轻快 / 宁静闲聊 / 深夜治愈」由插件实时演奏、无缝循环，也可以添加本地音乐；音量和选择会自动记住。

### New in v0.6.0
[该节后续省略]
### Compatibility and privacy
Preferences stay in local storage. A theatre picture or music file you add is kept in this browser's
IndexedDB and never uploaded; Remove deletes it. Chat history is never stored or sent to any extra
service; Log only reads messages already loaded on the page. Completion notifications are off by def
ault and ask for system permission only when you turn them on. Doctor counts page selectors locally
and copies no message content. Changing the interface language does not translate questions or answe
copies no message content. Changing the interface language does not translate questions or answers.
**Balance:** read through DSH's own account service, the same one its account card uses. It needs a
signed-in DeepSeek account; with an API key only, DSH has no balance to show. On DSH versions withou
t that service, opening DSH's account settings still lets her read it from the page. Unread values s
how as —, and values that have not refreshed recently are marked “not live”. “Bowls left” and low-ba
lance hints use fresh CNY data only.
**Pricing period:** follows DeepSeek's official rule. Peak is Beijing time, weekdays 09:00–12:00 and
14:00–18:00; other hours, weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak at half price. The holi
day table covers 2026 and is updated yearly.
**Swaying clothes:** only the skirt, hair ends and tail are deformed with WebGL; the face and upper
body stay exactly as drawn. Without WebGL, if the context is lost, or with reduced motion, the still
y as drawn. Without WebGL, if the context is lost, or with reduced motion, the still image is shown.
Response detection depends on DSH's page structure. Token speed appears only when DSH exposes it; ch
aracter counts are never shown as tokens/s. Code blocks and lists get dedicated formatting, but this
is not a full Markdown renderer. Expressions change by switching artwork; there is no lip-sync.
### 兼容性与隐私
偏好只保存在本地。你添加的剧场图片和音乐只保存在本机浏览器的 IndexedDB 中，不会上传，点「移除」即可删除。聊天记录不会被保存，也不会发送给任何额外服务；“回顾”只读取页面上已加载的消息。完成
通知默认关闭，只有你主动开启时才会申请系统权限。Doctor 只在本地统计页面选择器数量，不复制消息内容。切换界面语言不会翻译提问或回答。
**余额**：通过 DSH 自带账户卡片使用的同一个账户服务读取，需要登录 DeepSeek 账号；只使用 API Key 时 DSH 没有余额可显示。在没有该服务的 DSH 版本上，打开 DSH 账
户设置后她仍能从页面读取。未读取显示 —，一段时间没刷新的数据会标注“非实时”。“还能吃几碗”和低余额提醒只使用最新的人民币数据。
**计费时段**：按 DeepSeek 官方规则。北京时间工作日 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为高峰，其余时间以及周末、法定节假日为空闲时段，价格减半。节假日表目前覆盖 2026 年

**裙摆飘动**：只有裙摆、发梢和尾巴由 WebGL 形变，脸和上半身保持原画不变。不支持 WebGL、上下文丢失或开启减弱动效时显示静态立绘。
